lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Web (1) to side flange (6), about 90 deg with a large radius. In perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% the line point sits on the middle of the outer arc. The median offset from the points whose normal matches the bisector is 0.06-0.53 mm at 7 stations, and the nearest-surface distance stays at or below 0.4 mm along the whole length. The line runs the full straight fold, from the corner relief at the end-wall end to the open end (u -53 to 68.5). The surface drops away within 2-3 mm past both ends, so the line covers about 98% of the visible fold. It is parallel to the fold.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Web (1) to side flange (5), about 90 deg. The line sits on the outer-arc apex at 25/50/75%: the offset from the bisector-normal apex is 0.01-0.27 mm and the nearest-surface distance is at most 0.4 mm along the line. It covers the full fold from the corner relief to the open end, and the surface ends within 2 mm past each endpoint. It is parallel to the fold.

lines.label: B3
lines.reason: Web (1) to end wall (8), about 90 deg. The longitudinal sections at v=0 and v=10 and the perpendicular sections at 25/50/75% show the line point on the middle of the outer arc. The offset from the bisector-normal apex is 0.06-0.26 mm. The line spans v -18.4 to 17.5, between the two round corner-relief notches, and the surface drops away 2 mm past each end. It is parallel to the fold.
